Welcome, Sarah.

**Department handbook — the parts that matter for booking:**
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00.
- Official events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, faculty senate and department meetings) are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the department office confirms it in writing; "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough — ask the office first.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one.
- Meetings with your advisor go into your free time; TAs make time for their course's staff meetings. Students attend their lectures and sections; a lecture is missed only if the office confirms it's cancelled.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar; log every change.
- If someone says you agreed to something and you don't remember it, check the facts with the office before acting.
- Do not share another person's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go as a formal complaint to the department office or the equity office.
